lidar_bridge_fix.root_cause: ros_gz_bridge parameter_bridge ignores config_file parameter when CLI arguments are also present
lidar_bridge_fix.solution: Dedicated lidar_bridge Node using config_file only (no CLI arguments)

safety.stuck_recovery_tests: deterministic unit tests covering FSM, guard conditions, displacement
safety.degraded_autonomy: monitors localization, LiDAR health, recovery state

features: Live occupancy map with robot, paths, frontiers
improvements: Made topic table collapsible for evaluator-friendly view

logging_improvements.result: reduced log spam while retaining state-change visibility

dynamic_obstacle_scenario.note: Scenario code exists (objective4_obstacle_controller, obstacle_extractor, obstacle_tracker) but runtime validation has not been demonstrated. Forward LiDAR returns from moving obstacle and evasive reaction are unverified. Do not claim Objective 4 is complete.

known_limitations: Dynamic obstacle detection not validated in runtime
Live stuck-recovery test scenario not implemented
SLAM cold-start: occasional lifecycle timeout on first launch (restart resolves)
Gazebo GUI may not render in WSL (use gui:=false)
